lines.text: After His suffering, Jesus appeared to the apostles for forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
Jesus commanded the apostles not to leave Jerusalem but to wait for the gift the Father promised.
The apostles asked about restoring the kingdom to Israel, and Jesus said the Father fixed the times.
Jesus said the Holy Spirit would give the apostles power to be His witnesses in Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria, and Egypt.

wrong_details.true: to the ends of the earth

lines.text: A whirlwind hid Jesus as He rose, and two men in white said He will return the same way.
